def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(v):
        # Split by '+' to separate build metadata
        version_part, _, _ = v.partition('+')
        
        # Split by '-' to separate pre-release
        core_part, _, prerelease_part = version_part.partition('-')
        
        # Parse MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        parts = core_part.split('.')
        major = int(parts[0])
        minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease_part:
            identifiers = prerelease_part.split('.')
            for identifier in identifiers:
                # Check if all digits
                if identifier.isdigit():
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((0, int(identifier)))
                else:
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((1, identifier))
        
        return (major, minor, patch, len(prerelease_identifiers) == 0, prerelease_identifiers)
    
    def compare_key(item):
        index, v = item
        major, minor, patch, no_prerelease, prerelease_identifiers = parse_version(v)
        # For sorting: no_prerelease should be True (1) when there's no prerelease
        # But we want versions without prerelease to come AFTER versions with prerelease
        # So we need to invert: False when no prerelease (comes after), True when has prerelease
        has_prerelease = not no_prerelease
        return (major, minor, patch, not has_prerelease, prerelease_identifiers, index)
    
    # Use stable sort with indexed comparison
    indexed_versions = list(enumerate(versions))
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=compare_key)
    return [v for _, v in sorted_versions]
